name: Chris Church
headline: Global Partnerships & VP Partnerships APAC at Mercedes-AMG Petronas Formula One Team
about:
A proven commercial leader who has operated in organisations including Williams F1, SAS, IBM & CapGemini. 

Along with an enviable network I bring a clear sales methodology that is centred on my clients business objectives and an understanding of industry trends. This client focused strategy coupled with high activity, management of internal teams and external influencers has been key to my success working with large global organisations. 

I am also the co-founder of The Networking Board, which helps senior sales people to succeed and further their careers through our social events and networking.
… more
